build = r'''
exec(open(WORK/'feat_lib.py').read())
K_POS = 30; LAM = 0.3; S_BIG = 1e4; EPS_POOL = 0.02
def fit_ridge0(X, y, lam):
    Yt = np.eye(8)[y]; Yt = Yt - Yt.mean(0)
    return np.linalg.solve(X.T@X + lam*np.eye(X.shape[1]), X.T@Yt)
Pm = build_P(K_POS)
Fa = feats(Pm,'approx'); sc = np.linalg.norm(Fa,axis=1).mean(); Fa/=sc
Wm = fit_ridge0(Fa, y, LAM)                 # 768 x 8, z = Wm^T Fa
A = (Pm @ Wm).T / sc                         # 8 x 768 acting on n_j (normalized embedding)
g = base('bert.embeddings.LayerNorm.weight').astype(np.float64); bt = base('bert.embeddings.LayerNorm.bias').astype(np.float64)
G = A / g[None,:]                            # acts on x0 = g*n + bt
gbias = -(A @ (bt/g))
# readout directions q_c = (e_a - e_b)/sqrt2 on dims with small |beta|
order = np.argsort(np.abs(bt) + 0.1*np.abs(g))
dims = order[:16]
Qd = np.zeros((768,8))
for c in range(8):
    Qd[dims[2*c],c] = 1/np.sqrt(2); Qd[dims[2*c+1],c] = -1/np.sqrt(2)
f32 = lambda a: np.asarray(a, dtype=np.float32)
z768 = np.zeros((768,768)); 
# ---- layer 0 attention
L0 = 'bert.encoder.layer.0.'
save_edit(L0+'attention.self.query.weight', f32(z768)); save_edit(L0+'attention.self.query.bias', f32(np.zeros(768)))
save_edit(L0+'attention.self.key.weight', f32(z768)); save_edit(L0+'attention.self.key.bias', f32(np.zeros(768)))
Wv = np.zeros((768,768)); Wv[:8] = G; bv = np.zeros(768); bv[:8] = gbias
save_edit(L0+'attention.self.value.weight', f32(Wv)); save_edit(L0+'attention.self.value.bias', f32(bv))
Wo = np.zeros((768,768)); Wo[:, :8] = S_BIG*Qd
save_edit(L0+'attention.output.dense.weight', f32(Wo)); save_edit(L0+'attention.output.dense.bias', f32(np.zeros(768)))
# ---- all layers: LN -> identity affine, FFN output -> 0; layers 1..11 attention output -> 0
for l in range(12):
    p = f'bert.encoder.layer.{l}.'
    for ln in ['attention.output.LayerNorm.','output.LayerNorm.']:
        save_edit(p+ln+'weight', f32(np.ones(768))); save_edit(p+ln+'bias', f32(np.zeros(768)))
    save_edit(p+'output.dense.weight', f32(np.zeros((768,3072)))); save_edit(p+'output.dense.bias', f32(np.zeros(768)))
    if l>0:
        save_edit(p+'attention.output.dense.weight', f32(z768)); save_edit(p+'attention.output.dense.bias', f32(np.zeros(768)))
# ---- pooler & classifier
Wp = np.zeros((768,768)); Wp[:8] = EPS_POOL*Qd.T
save_edit('bert.pooler.dense.weight', f32(Wp)); save_edit('bert.pooler.dense.bias', f32(np.zeros(768)))
Wc = np.zeros((8,768)); Wc[np.arange(8),np.arange(8)] = 1.0
save_edit('classifier.weight', f32(Wc)); save_edit('classifier.bias', f32(np.zeros(8)))
np.save(WORK/'readout_dims.npy', dims)
print('saved; sc', sc, 'dims', dims)
'''
open(WORK/'build.py','w').write(build)
exec(build)

print('cancel check', np.abs(ctx - A@u).max(), np.abs(A@u).max())
